# VPS Proxy Deployment Guide

> Agent-readable index for a self-hosted Hysteria2, VLESS and Clash Verge Rev guide. Templates only; no live service or credentials. Updated 2026-09-28.

## Start here
- [Overview](README.md): scope, architecture, limits and tests.
- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): permissions, privacy and staged deployment.
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): VPS selection to client setup.
- [Parameters](docs/parameters.example.md): values the recipient must supply.
- [Verification](docs/verification.md): real-world acceptance and recovery.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): concise answers to common questions.
- [Release status](docs/release-status.md): offline evidence and publication limits.

## Task paths
- Family/friend sharing: [3X-UI integration](docs/3x-ui-family-sharing.md). Choose panel-managed inbounds before installing standalone services; verify two separate users, quotas, expiry, subscriptions and revocation. Reference: v3.8.5 official sources, not a fresh-VPS acceptance result.
- New deployment: read the agent contract, parameters, deployment stage table, rebuild runbook and verification checklist. Complete HY2, CDN and IPv4 VLESS fallback; a working HY2-only stage is not the final multi-route result.
- Client setup or failover: [client guide](docs/client-failover.md). Self-hosted routes use priority fallback, without external VPN subscriptions; match instructions to the active panel script.
- Official client download: https://github.com/clash-verge-rev/clash-verge-rev/releases

## Implementation
- [Client template](templates/clash.example.yaml): placeholders only.
- [Profile script](scripts/shared-profile.js): supported four-role transformation.
- [Tests](tests/profile.test.js): offline behavior checks.

- [部署与恢复执行手册](docs/rebuild-runbook.md)：安装映射、续期、多用户边界和恢复顺序。
